// diagnostic

E0391

`#run { … }` is used as a value in a form this compiler does not support yet.

What

`#run { … }` is used as a value in a form this compiler does not support yet.

Why

Jet makes the block's final expression its value. Today only a binding `name: #run { value }` whose block holds a single final expression is evaluated while building.

Fix

Write `name: #run value` with one final expression, or bind the result inside a `#run { … }` statement block.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0391: tests/ui/computed_alias_condition_is_not_a_bool.stderr.

Error [jet.UnsupportedCompileTimeValue]: This condition isn't a `Bool` decided while building
  --> tests/ui/computed_alias_condition_is_not_a_bool.jet:15:34
    |
 15 | Storage<N: Int>: Store #run { if N -> Heap else -> Heap }
    |                                  ^
 Why: A computed alias chooses its type while building, from its number parameters and the module's constants
 Fix: Compare the `Int` parameters with literals or constants, such as `N <= 16`
